task.title: P6-129: Freeze page identity while a tree dialog is open during a view_res refetch
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, /my collection page, tree and collection header). Original id: P6-129. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**While a `view_res` refetch is in flight, the page behind an open tree dialog can change identity** (was `P6-017d`; **rescoped 2026-07-29, the original claim was more alarming than the code**). Verified in `specs/phase-6-probes/P6-017d-confirm-copy.md`: the dialog is **not** mis-aimed. Its title is `format!("Delete {name}?")` read from the same `DeleteReq` snapshot `submit_delete` acts on (`tree_manage.rs:733`, `:604-609`), and it is mounted at the app shell (`shell.rs:292`), above both of `collection.rs`'s `<Transition>` blocks — so it names A and deletes A throughout. The residual defect is the milder one: when B's payload lands, the header *underneath* swaps to B while the open dialog still shows A, so the confirm names a collection the visible page no longer shows. Fix by freezing or annotating the page identity while a tree dialog is open.
